facts.fact: A police divisional commissioner said on 14 April 2026 that all commissariats and gendarmerie brigades in Togo have the SIPAO tool; this is a statement by the police, with no count of stations given.
SIPAO is an ECOWAS programme implemented by INTERPOL with EU funding; it was handed to ECOWAS and national authorities on 8 April 2025 after EU funding ended.

systems.owner: ECOWAS, implemented by INTERPOL; Togo's Police Information Centre (CIPT)
systems.tiers: all commissariats and gendarmerie brigades said to have the tool; police archives of procès-verbaux digitised
